rows: Which mother, letter, pitch, and Tree assignments are possible or mathematically impossible
Which transformations can actually be generated from SUN, and which require additional structure
Whether Sefer's gates, TOL paths, and musical states have compatible structures rather than merely matching counts
Whether one decoded relationship correctly predicts another that was not used to construct it
Whether the observed agreement is exceptional or common under arbitrary assignments
Whether the proposed intervals produce the predicted beating, convergence, and melodic behavior
Whether Mi→Fa→Mi, octave changes, and letter transformations obey consistent composition rules

occurrences.exact_quote:
| Test | Method | What it can settle |
|--------|--------|--------|
| **1\. SAT/SMT constraint solving** | Z3, theorem prover | Which mother, letter, pitch, and Tree assignments are possible or mathematically impossible |
| **2\. Exhaustive algebraic search** | SymPy, exact rational arithmetic | Which transformations can actually be generated from SUN, and which require additional structure |
| **3\. Graph isomorphism and embedding** | NetworkX, VF2 | Whether Sefer's gates, TOL paths, and musical states have compatible structures rather than merely matching counts |
| **4\. Blind prediction** | Holdout testing | Whether one decoded relationship correctly predicts another that was not used to construct it |
| **5\. Null-model testing** | Permutation and Monte Carlo tests | Whether the observed agreement is exceptional or common under arbitrary assignments |
| **6\. Audio and signal analysis** | NumPy, SciPy, Fourier analysis | Whether the proposed intervals produce the predicted beating, convergence, and melodic behavior |
| **7\. Boundary and state-machine testing** | Exhaustive transition enumeration | Whether Mi→Fa→Mi, octave changes, and letter transformations obey consistent composition rules |
